title: Notify the requester after durable native completion, then perform a targeted authenticated causal pull
outcome: Notify the requester after durable native completion, then perform a targeted authenticated causal pull
acceptance: After a native causal completion is durably retained, the runner sends an idempotent completion-ready hint containing the original causal key and run id over the existing authenticated relay to the original requester; a failed persistence emits no success notification.

The requester uses a valid hint only to schedule its original pending key immediately, then performs the existing authenticated ReadCausalTestCompletion and all custody, origin, mode, input, terminal and post-I/O checks before ordinary idempotent settlement; duplicate, stale and forged hints create no completion or credit.

Lost notification, disconnect and restart remain recoverable through the durable pending set. Behavioral tests cover successful and failed persistence, duplicate hints, authentication/currentness refusal and targeted recovery.
The independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding and the full gate passes on the exact landed input.
